title: Meri tarah mere baba ,koi yateem na ho
body:
Meri tarah mere baba ,koi yateem na ho
hui hai jaise sakina, koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
yateem ho ke yateemi ka dard samjha hai
ye gham saha nahi jata ,koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
suna tha log yateemn se pyar karte hai'n
mai bad naseeb hun baba,koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to sar pa mohabbat se hath rakh deta
koi to deta dilaasa, koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
na aap aate hai baba na mout aati hai
azaab ho gaya jeena, koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhe yateemi ka ehsaas yeh dilaata hai
mera phata hua kurta,koi yateem na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
juda na ho kabhi *irfan* baap, beti se
uthe na baap ka saya, koi yateem na ho
